metadata.order: Six permutations of three systems; same deterministic input within run; no slow samples discarded
metadata.parallelism: Both pools fixed to --threads. Mikros tree construction and sumcheck/fold loops are scalar; shared eq_table uses Rayon for large tables. Flock uses its production parallel path. Initial subfield caches included in saved warmups.

metadata.scope: Same public known permutation f[sigma[i]]=g[i]. Mikros: injective (value,tag) tuples; Flock: production tagged batched product-GKR, no mask. PIOP only; no PCS/ZK/grinding/equal-security assertion.

source_manifest.scope: Exact existing permutation/tree/sumcheck/encoding/oracle sources and Flock crates. Lookup lib.rs/Cargo.toml expose permutation only; unrelated Lasso, Hadamard and in-progress WHIR code is not compiled.

metadata.timing: prepare: native representation from common raw inputs; prover_core: actual prove including internal checks/hashing; total: prepare+core. Common input generation/digest and challenger prefix are outside. All original source claims checked outside; Flock sigma-aware verifier additionally timed.
